title: Captions with precise editing
description: A line can be fixed, split and placed without changing the neighboring captions.

blocks.text: Automatic text often needs a little work by hand. Unpredictable movement turns that into styling the clip all over again.

quote.text: sometimes when you are editing a caption and try to move it to the correct place- it gets stuck on other captions sometimes in the middle of another caption and you cant unstick it!

blocks.text: Tie a line to the audio and let time and position be controlled separately. Check line breaks and overlaps in a full preview.
The shared style and the individual exceptions have to be stored separately. A new font setting must not destroy corrections made by hand.
